stem:
A restaurant sells 38 pizzas on Wednesday. The expression 38 \times 2 can be used to find the number of pizzas the restaurant sells on Saturday.

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: There are 38 times as many pizzas sold on Wednesday as on Saturday.

options.label: B
options.text: There are 2 times as many pizzas sold on Wednesday as on Saturday.

options.label: C
options.text: There are 2 times as many pizzas sold on Saturday as on Wednesday.

options.label: D
options.text: There are 38 times as many pizzas sold on Saturday as on Wednesday.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding multiplication as a comparison between two quantities (relation between Wednesday and Saturday sales) and interpreting the expression correctly to identify the true statement.
